run_echo_worker: run an actionengine worker that listens on a redis queue and echoes input messages to output
create_action_registry: create an action registry that registers an echo action with its schema and handler function
build_redis_chunk_store: build a redis chunk store with a given node id and no TTL for actionengine data persistence
listen_execute_actions: listen on a redis queue and execute actions from incoming wire messages using an action registry
configure_global_settings: configure actionengine global settings to enable automatic deserialization and preserve read chunks
